links.outcome: Glaucoma detection AUC stratified by race, age, and disease severity
links.effect: No significant differences by race or age in unimodal or multimodal models. All models performed better for moderate-to-severe than mild glaucoma, significant for CFP (P=0.002) and OCT (P=0.005) unimodal models.
links.quote: No significant differences based on race or age were found in either unimodal or multimodal glaucoma detection models.

screen.reason: Evaluates multimodal vs unimodal foundation model (RETFound) performance and subgroup fairness (demographic/severity stratification) on retrospective clinical datasets without testing a clinical deployment safeguard or organizational practice.
